title: An affine scheme etale over an open of a curve is an affine curve
statement: Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field, $C$ a curve over $k$ [def-sc-curves], $U\subseteq C$ an open subscheme and $w:W\to U$ an etale morphism [def-weil-etale-morphism] with $W$ an affine scheme. Then $W$, with the structure morphism $W\xrightarrow{w}U\hookrightarrow C\to\operatorname{Spec}k$, is an affine curve over $k$: it is separated and of finite type over $k$ and of dimension at most one.
